## Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored API

Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored is a large language model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `qwen-3-6-plus`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored is an uncensored variant of Alibaba's Qwen 3.6 Plus, a reasoning model with exceptional performance across coding, reasoning, and general knowledge tasks. Features mixed reasoning, function calling, and multimodal input support.

### Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen-3-6-plus` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.625 / $3.75 per 1M |

### Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Apr 6, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "qwen-3-6-plus"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen-3-6-plus",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
